products.name: AXL
products.tagline: GTM copilot for AI product founders: 1,200+ actions via MCP
products.description: Capture leads, close sales & onboard customers in one system: pages, quizzes, webinars, courses, video hosting & streaming, email, chat, CRM, telephony & AI calls. No integrations to build & maintain. Every interaction enriches each lead's history. Our AI model, trained on 1M deals from AXL users, scores leads using 300+ signals to help your AI & sales team decide who to follow up with, when & how. Give ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor access to lead context & 1,200+ sales & marketing actions via MCP.

products.name: Product Hunt MCP
products.tagline: The community you trust in the assistant you use
products.description: Ask your AI assistant to find your next favorite product. Explore new launches, compare alternatives, and see what the Product Hunt community thinks. Building something yourself? Turn your README and website into a launch draft, add images, and check what's missing before you submit. Sign in with Product Hunt to connect. No API key needed.

products.name: Sage2 by Levanto Labs
products.tagline: Turn live talk into structured data and instant actions
products.description: Sage2 gives developers APIs to extract structured data from natural language and make streaming decisions as conversations evolve. Extract values like dates, amounts, and durations, track changing user intent, and build applications that know what to do next.

products.name: Inkling 2 Small
products.tagline: A model that can see and refine what it builds
products.description: Inkling 2 Small is Thinking Machines Lab's new 594B-parameter MoE model with 17B active, built for long-horizon coding, visual tasks, and agents. Available on Tinker for inference and fine-tuning.

products.name: Deduplication
products.description: Bug used to mean an insect. Mouse, an animal. Token, a coin. Tech keeps borrowing words, and deduplication.tech measures which meaning is winning. 719 duplicated terms across 14 fields (AI, crypto, gaming, cloud and more). Each pair is scored with live Wikipedia pageviews: the original still owns it, it's contested, or the duplicate took over. Explore the word cloud, leaderboards and term pages. Free and open, by HackerNoon.

products.name: NoMac
products.tagline: Your AI agent's own Mac, billed per minute. No subscription
products.description: Give Claude Code, Codex or Cursor its own Mac in the cloud: Xcode on Apple silicon, ready in about 30 seconds. Your agent builds your iOS app, runs it on an iPhone Simulator you can watch live, and ships it to TestFlight and the App Store. Then the Mac shuts down. Billed per minute from prepaid credit, no subscription: a whole build costs a few cents.

products.name: DocsAlot for customer support
products.tagline: Slack and Discord bot that answers your customers questions
products.description: DocsAlot can now answer common customers questions, in slack and discord, based on your existing knowledge-base

products.name: Archie
products.description: Archie — a small Mac app that keeps screenshots in your notch, ready to edit and drag wherever you need them.

products.name: Zigzag Browser
products.tagline: The polished, native Mac browser for life after Arc
products.description: A native Mac browser for people leaving Arc, with the sidebar and spaces you're used to. Built on WebKit, not Chromium, and that's the point: the whole app is 18 MB (Arc is 871). Switching takes a minute. One import brings over everything, so you're already logged in. Colored spaces you swipe between, split view, peek, Chrome extensions like 1Password and Tampermonkey, and ad blocking built-in Open source, no account, no AI. Nobody can shut it down.

products.name: outages.live
products.tagline: A free live outage feed for your agents
products.description: Check whether a provider is down before debugging your code. outages.live brings official status pages for cloud, AI, payments, and developer tools into one feed, refreshed every few minutes. Give your coding agent outage context over MCP, browse the live feed, or subscribe via RSS, Atom, JSON Feed, or Slack. Free, with no login or API key.

products.name: Agent Clan
products.tagline: Command your Claude Code and Codex agents with gestures
products.description: Agent Clan puts your Claude Code and Codex agents on your screen as a 3D team you run with your hands. Make a fist and they appear. Pinch and pull toward one to pick it, then just say what you need. When an agent asks for permission, pull right to allow or left to deny. Circle anything on your screen to hand it over, or ask a leader and its crew splits the work. Hand tracking and voice run on your computer, and everything also works with a mouse. Free on Mac and Windows.

products.name: Tilde 
products.tagline: Finder replacement & file manager for mac
products.description: Tilde is the native Finder replacement for Mac. Browse folders in custom split layouts, organise files by status or client with custom properties, restore tabs and layouts with saved workspaces, and too much more to list. Purchase once, no subscription.

products.name: NotchIsland
products.tagline: Free, open-source Dynamic Island for the MacBook notch
products.description: NotchIsland turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island: a true-black surface that grows out of the notch when something is live (Now Playing, timers, AirPods battery, downloads, notifications) and disappears when nothing is. Hover for a readout; click for a shade with quick toggles, a timer, your next meeting with a Join button, a file Shelf and clipboard history. Option-Space opens a launcher with app search, calculator and unit conversion. Forever free, open source (MIT), macOS 13+.

products.name: Keypause
products.tagline: Turn off your Mac's keyboard while you clean it
products.description: Press one button. Wipe your keyboard. Done. A Mac menu bar app that locks every key while a sleepy keycap waits for sunrise.

products.name: Textly
products.tagline: Capture Text & Tables from Anywhere on Your Mac
products.description: Stop retyping text and rebuilding tables. Textly lets you instantly capture text from anywhere on your Mac — even when you can't select or copy it. Extract tables from screenshots, PDFs, videos, and apps while keeping rows and columns intact. Export to CSV, Markdown, or TSV, translate text instantly, and revisit previous captures with clipboard history. Just select an area, capture, and get back to what matters.
